title: SharkNinja CEO Mark Barrocas named an Entrepreneur Of The Year® 2026 National Award winner in Consumer Products
summary: SharkNinja CEO Mark Barrocas named an Entrepreneur Of The Year® 2026 National Award winner in Consumer Products. The latest on SharkNinja innovations—press releases, product launches, media kits, images, and press contacts.
body_markdown:
Ernst & Young LLP (EY US) named SharkNinja CEO Mark Barrocas an


[Entrepreneur Of The Year®](https://www.ey.com/en_us/entrepreneur-of-the-year-us) 2026 National Award winner in the Consumer Products category. The national recognition follows Barrocas’ selection as a New England regional award winner in June 2026.


For over four decades, the Entrepreneur Of The Year program has recognized entrepreneurs who are


revolutionizing industries, strengthening communities and leading businesses that will shape the future.


Under Barrocas’ leadership,


SharkNinja has grown into one of the fastest-growing product design and consumer technology companies in the world, with approximately $7 billion in net sales over the last 12 months through Q3 2026.


During his 18 years at SharkNinja, he has cultivated a culture that encourages ambition and challenges teams to exceed their own expectations. He has made experimentation and continuous learning central to how SharkNinja operates, strengthening the company’s ability to innovate.


An independent panel of entrepreneurs and business leaders selected the national winners from 209 regional award winners representing 184 companies across the United States. Judges assessed candidates on how they create long-term value through entrepreneurial spirit, purpose, growth and impact.


Barrocas joins leaders from across the United States in retail, financial services and technology among the Entrepreneur Of The Year® 2026 National Award winners.


[See the full list of national winners.](https://www.ey.com/en_us/entrepreneur-of-the-year-us)


“Being named an Entrepreneur Of The Year winner is a defining moment that celebrates an entrepreneur’s vision, leadership and impact, while opening the door to lasting opportunities for growth and connection,” said Anna Horndahl, EY Americas Entrepreneurship Leader and EY US Assurance Partner. “Honorees join a trusted community of peers who can offer valuable insights and support as they navigate what comes next. Through the broader EY entrepreneurial ecosystem, we help them build relationships, access new opportunities and continue to grow their business long after the awards.”


Since 1986, Entrepreneur Of The Year has honored business leaders for their ingenuity, courage and entrepreneurial spirit. The program recognizes original founders who built businesses from the ground up, transformational CEOs who drive growth and innovation, and family business leaders who evolve legacy businesses for future generations.
